description: This file configures testing parameters for 'extension-messaging' in a Vitest environment. It imports paths, pattern loaders, and scoped configuration functions, then defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration specifically for extension messaging tests.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include test file patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if none specified.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig( createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension-messaging tests, using include patterns from environment or default root patterns.
